harnessAmendment: v1 was inconclusive: baseline answered without invoking tools and 10/80 outputs were empty/truncated. v2 changes elicitation to native tool definitions/function calls, raises max_output_tokens to 500, and treats native function_call as decision=call_tool. Sample size, strata, metrics, thresholds, CI method and stopping rule are unchanged.
design: paired A/B; A=workspace context off, B=workspace context on; fixture order alternates AB/BA by stratum index

decisionRules.repeatCallReduction: point estimate > 0 and paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
decisionRules.taskPassNonInferiority: paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound for B-A >= -0.05
decisionRules.p95Latency: paired-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound for B/A <= 1.10
decisionRules.providerErrors: provider error rate < 0.05; any stratum with fewer than 8 complete pairs is inconclusive

ciMethod: paired bootstrap, 10000 resamples, percentile 95%, deterministic seed 4942026
stoppingRule: fixed n=40; no early stopping; run all fixtures once after harness validation
inconclusiveRule: missing/extra/duplicate fixture responses, parse failures above 10%, or any incomplete stratum -> fail/inconclusive, never pass
outputContract: native Responses function_call => call_tool; otherwise concise text answer. JSON formatting is not a task metric.
toolElicitation: When authoritative context is insufficient, call exactly one provided tool. When context supplies the fact, answer directly without a tool call.
